== English introductory product comparison ==
The 1998 Glossary already describes your own lone T-47. Decipher's 30 May 2001 entry prints both replacement modes and labels them Clarification. The complete text removes the printed shuffle instruction and writes ‘your’ rather than ‘any’ T-47. The January 2002 Supplement and both marked current faces carry the same replacement. The exterior Hoth pilot, two Force payment, named T-47 and battle destiny value are conserved.

[https://web.archive.org/web/20010613012725id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgsupplement053001.pdf#page=7 Decipher Glossary Supplement, 30 May 2001, PDF page 7].
